title: Dino × Jev
description: I let Jev play Chrome’s dinosaur game, and after a few rounds of tweaking the prompt, I couldn’t get it to crash. The game shows Jev what’s coming and gives it a few plans to pick from. Turns out that’s enough.
imageAlt: The dinosaur jumping over the desert ground in Dino × Jev.

title: Tic-tac-toe
description: Jev hasn’t lost to me at tic-tac-toe yet. Unfortunately, I can’t say the same.
imageAlt: A tic-tac-toe board with crosses and circles.

title: Kerai Race
description: I spent a weekend recreating Road Rash, a game I played as a kid, using the map of my own village.

title: Labour Thekedar
description: A labor payment and attendance management app for contractors.
